compute_binary_recall: compute binary recall score from predictions and references lists of integer labels
compute_multiclass_recall: compute multiclass recall with macro, micro, or weighted averaging across classes
compute_recall_with_weights: compute recall using sample weights to weight each example's contribution
compute_per_class_recall: compute per-class recall scores by setting average to None for individual class results
compute_multilabel_recall: compute recall for multilabel classification with sequence-based predictions and references
